title: Harness tier-score-guard: referenced skill scores too low
desc: Blocks an Agent dispatch (or skill use) when a skill referenced in the brief scores below threshold, meaning it is a fat un-tiered skill the successor cannot use efficiently. Split it into 3 tiers first.
steps: TRIGGER: fires when a brief-referenced skill has a tier/coverage score under 60 (or 80 in stricter mode) -- a sign it is a monolith, not a 3-tier T1/T2/T3 cluster.
FIX: split the low-score skill into T1 core + T2 howto + T3 ref via the migration guide, then re-reference it. Raising the score unblocks the dispatch (gate-as-incentive).
WHY: fat skills are token-hostile and the next agent skips them; the score routes you to fix the knowledge before relying on it. See: skill-migration-3tier, skill-3tier-lazy-arch.
author: claude
